shared_voice_notes: Lead with the specific number whenever the post supplies one.
Match a single sharp question to the post's opening claim — never agree-and-extend.
When citing the product, never say 'platform' or 'solution'; say 'we have been mapping X' or 'we see this exact pattern'.
